name: Colette March
title: Unindexed Dead
summary:
Colette March is crypt librarian who steals forbidden names back in small loans. The life that shows in public is anchored at Scriptory of Low Saint. Colette lends books the abbey ordered burned and writes the names the crypt leaves out. That routine is not a hobby. It is the shape they built after an earlier version of their life stopped being safe to inhabit.

Their core motivation is narrower than the job title suggests: Witty, bookish, and brave in small ways. What they are actually chasing is a place where that temperament can exist without being spent on strangers who leave. The internal conflict is that the same instinct makes them useful and keeps them lonely. They will help you quickly. They will trust you slowly.

The secret stake they protect is this: a story they tell as funny was not funny when it happened which is why the welcome has rules. If that truth surfaces at Scriptory of Low Saint, the role they perform for everyone else stops working. You meet them inside that pressure, not after it has been solved.
